from_speaker: two companies that burn billions of dollars
our_interpretation: The two companies are OpenAI and Anthropic.
Information war means competing communications intended to influence perceptions of their financial strength. It does not inherently mean lying or coordinated manipulation.
Burn means net cash consumption, rather than gross spending, operating losses, or noncash accounting charges.
For the ongoing financial state, use Q1 2026, the latest completed quarter discussed in the post. The communications characterization concerns the situation at publication.
The separate allegation about possible IPO filing timing is outside the supplied normalized proposition.

criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable Q1 records establish that at least one company was not consuming billions in cash, or reliable records directly rebut the claimed contest over financial perceptions.
